user.title: Sonos Smart Groups
user.description: A precedence lock lets one smart group outrank another. Name one per situation that should be able to take over your speakers — Home theater, Doorbell, Party. Separate several with commas; you can change this later.

data.flavour: Players to build the blueprint around

data_description.flavour: Pick the integration you actually control your speakers with. The Music Assistant blueprint leaves out the equalizer options, which do nothing for its players.

abort.already_configured: Sonos Smart Groups is already set up.

init.title: Precedence locks
init.description: One switch is created per name. Removing a name deletes its switch, so check that no smart group still refers to it.

apply.name: Apply smart group

followers.name: Followers
followers.description: Speakers with their factors and whether to group.

tolerance.name: Tolerance
tolerance.description: Volume points below which nothing is written.

take_precedence.description: Hold a lock and record the principal.

principal.name: Principal
principal.description: The leader of the superior smart group.

blueprint_modified.title: A blueprint was left alone
blueprint_modified.description:
`{name}` differs from the version shipped with this update, so it looks like you edited it and it has not been replaced.

Your automations keep working on your version. To take the new one, delete `{path}` and reload the Sonos Smart Groups integration.
